branchName.instructions: Use the format <type>/<short-kebab-description>, where <type> is a Conventional Commits type (feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore).

commitMessage.instructions: Follow Conventional Commits v1.0.0: <type>(<optional scope>): <imperative description>, with types feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore. Mark breaking changes with ! after the type/scope or a BREAKING CHANGE footer.

pullRequest.instructions: Title follows Conventional Commits v1.0.0: <type>(<optional scope>): <description>. Body summarizes the changes and includes a BREAKING CHANGE section when applicable.

setup: docker compose run --rm dev_frontend npm ci
docker compose run --rm --no-deps -e COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 dev_backend composer install --no-interaction
docker compose run --rm dev_backend php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --allow-no-migration -n
docker compose run --rm dev_backend php bin/console lexik:jwt:generate-keypair --skip-if-exists -n

backend.command: BIND_IP=$HOST BACKEND_PORT=$PASEO_PORT DB_PORT=0 docker compose up dev_backend dev_database

frontend.command: BIND_IP=$HOST FRONTEND_PORT=$PASEO_PORT docker compose up dev_frontend
